A '''2-1B surgical droid''' was present at the [[Grand Republic Medical Facility]] with a [[DD-13 medical assistant droid]], [[FX-6]],<ref name="Episode III" /> and another [[FX-9 surgical assistant]].<ref name="Journeys Beginnings">''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]''</ref> The droids helped rebuild the body of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] following his [[Duel on Mustafar|defeat]] at the hands of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Mustafar]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> The three droids were later moved to [[Fortress Vader]] on [[Mustafar]].<ref name="The Dark Side" />
